map.使用十字交叉法，根据两种原料的营养成分配制目标含量的饲料。: Use the Pearson square to blend two ingredients to a target nutrient content.
map.A 占比 = |B − T| ÷ (|B − T| + |A − T|)；B 占: A share = |B - T| / (|B - T| + |A - T|); B share = |A - T| / (|B - T| + |A - T|); ingredient weight = share x total weight
map.十字交叉法（Pearson 平方）配比：目标含量 T 需介于原料 A、B 含量之: Pearson square: target T must lie between A and B contents. A parts = |B - T|, B parts = |A - T|, each share = parts / sum of parts (T closer to one means more of the other). Multiply shares by total weight for ingredient weights; verify by weighted average of blended content.
map.💡 十字交叉法：A 比例 = |B含量 − 目标| ÷ (|A含量 − 目标|: 💡 Pearson square: A ratio = |B content - target| / (|A content - target| + |B content - target|)
map.目标含量必须介于两种原料含量之间，否则无法配制: Target content must lie between the two ingredient contents, else blending is impossible
map.计算结果为理论配比，实际配料需考虑氨基酸平衡、能量、矿物质等: Result is theoretical; actual mixing must consider amino-acid balance, energy, minerals, etc.
map.按目标粗蛋白/能量反推各原料占比，多原料用联立方程或试差法。: Back-calculate ingredient shares from target crude protein/energy; multiple ingredients use simultaneous equations or trial-and-error.
map.满足最低成本约束下的营养平衡。: Achieve nutrient balance under least-cost constraint.
map.用于畜禽自配料与全价料配方优化。: For livestock self-mixing and complete-feed formulation optimization.
map.玉米（CP 8%）与豆粕（CP 44%）两种原料配到 16%：设豆粕比例 x，则: Corn (CP 8%) and soybean meal (CP 44%) blended to 16%: let meal ratio x, 0.44x + 0.08(1-x) = 0.16 -> x = 0.222. So 22.2% meal, 77.8% corn reaches 16% CP (amino balance not counted; lysine supplement needed).
map.不够。能量、氨基酸（赖、蛋）、钙磷比同样关键。商业配方用线性规划同时约束多项营养: No. Energy, amino acids (lysine, methionine), Ca:P ratio are also key. Commercial formulas use linear programming for multi-nutrient and cost; manual suits simple two-ingredient mixing.
map.是带约束的线性规划：目标函数=∑价格×用量，约束=各营养≥需求、用量≥0、总和=: It is constrained linear programming: objective = sum(price x amount), constraints = each nutrient >= demand, amount >= 0, sum = 100%. Use solver or dedicated formulation software.
